tokens.v: Each phase makes what the next one needs. Item Defaults is keyed by item group, so groups come before defaults; an item inherits its subentities from the defaults, so defaults come before items; a BOM and a routing are written against an item, a cost is calculated from them, and stock is booked for a component that already has purchase data. Nothing here is alphabetical and nothing walks the menu.
